title: The Factors Affecting Atopic Dermatitis in Children Age 1-3
brief_summary: This study evaluates the influence of different triggers on atopic dermatitis manifestation in children under 3 years old.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* children 1-3 age without rash, without atopic dermatitis
* children 1-3 age with recurrent atopic dermatitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* children 1-3 age with non-specific rush
* children age 1-2 with atopic dermatitis without rush during previous year
